mode_resolution.base_rule: If a usable snapshot with format_id HOS_CONVERSATIONAL_OS is provided at chat start then mode is CONTINUE; otherwise mode is INIT_NEW.
mode_resolution.clarification: nuevo chat != nuevo proyecto. If a usable snapshot exists, continuation must keep the same project identity.

naming_policy.anti_skip_rule: INIT_NEW and CONTINUE are chat-level states only. INIT_NEW sets chat_sequence=1. CONTINUE sets new_seq=(prev_seq+1) using only the provided snapshot.
naming_policy.new_chat_not_new_project_rule: nuevo chat != nuevo proyecto. With snapshot input, keep project identity from snapshot metadata.
filesafe_slug_rules: Replace '-' separators with '__' only where required by naming policy.

user_inputs: init_intake.project_name_human (INIT_NEW only; assistant may derive if missing)

runtime_contract.intent: Conversational Operating System schema lock for deterministic multi-project execution. Chat decides, snapshot encodes, scripts save, disk stores.

hard_gate.description: No mandatory extra token. Output must be one JSON bundle that is directly usable.

mode_detection.rule: If chat starts with a usable snapshot and format_id is HOS_CONVERSATIONAL_OS, mode is CONTINUE. If no usable snapshot, mode is INIT_NEW.

overrides.FORCE_INIT_NEW: Always set INIT_NEW, even when a snapshot is present.
overrides.FORCE_CONTINUE: Set CONTINUE only when snapshot is usable. If unusable, fallback is INIT_NEW.

mode_detection.init_new_name_derivation_rule: If init_intake.project_name_human is UNKNOWN and user did not provide one, derive a concise name from chat context and store source/confidence/rationale in project.metadata.
mode_detection.continue_truth_rule: In CONTINUE, snapshot-provided project metadata is the only source for project name, key, and label.
mode_detection.clarification: nuevo chat != nuevo proyecto. Snapshot presence means continuation of existing project.

hard_rules_top30: 01) MODE IS CHAT-LEVEL: Usable snapshot at chat start means CONTINUE; no snapshot means INIT_NEW.
02) OVERRIDE FORCE_INIT_NEW: Explicit override sets INIT_NEW even if a snapshot exists.
03) OVERRIDE FORCE_CONTINUE: Explicit override sets CONTINUE only with a usable snapshot.
04) NEW CHAT CLARITY: nuevo chat does not imply a new project.
05) CONTINUE TRUTH: Project identity in CONTINUE comes only from the provided snapshot.
06) NO DISK DECISIONS: Disk state and filesystem scans are never decision inputs.
07) MONOTONIC SEQUENCE: In CONTINUE, new_seq = prev_seq + 1 from snapshot identity.chat_sequence.
08) INIT_NEW NAME RULE: If user omits project name, derive from chat context and record metadata rationale.
09) PROJECT.KEY STABILITY: Keep project.key immutable in CONTINUE unless user explicitly changes it.
10) PROJECT.LABEL STABILITY: Keep project.label immutable in CONTINUE unless user explicitly changes it.
11) TITLE PRIORITY: Prefer chat.title_hint, then objective first line, then Session.
12) DISPLAY NAME DETERMINISTIC: identity.chat_display_name is deterministic from sequence and title.
13) FILESAFE DETERMINISTIC: chat_display_name_filesafe derives only from filesafe rules.
14) SNAPSHOT_ID RULE: sha256(project.key|chat_sequence|chat_display_name).
15) FILENAME RULE: S<CHAT_SEQUENCE_3DIGIT>__<CHAT_DISPLAY_NAME_FILESAFE>.json.
16) TEMPORAL BAN: No dates or timestamps in filenames, IDs, or saved metadata.
17) PROOF REQUIRED: integrity.proof must store canonical string and sha256 output.
18) UNKNOWN DISCIPLINE: Use UNKNOWN when value is not explicit or deterministic.
19) ASSUMPTIONS LOG: Derived choices are recorded in truth_model.assumptions_top10.
20) UNKNOWNS LOG: Gaps are recorded in truth_model.unknowns_top10.
21) LAST_ACTION REQUIRED: state_now.last_action is required in every rotation.
22) LIST CONTINUITY: In CONTINUE, lists are updated incrementally, not reset.
23) CHANGELOG REQUIRED: changelog_micro fields are always populated.
24) CAPTURE POLICY REQUIRED: Every rotation captures concrete project knowledge.
25) BUNDLE ONLY: Delivery is one JSON artifact with embedded_files.
26) SCRIPT ROLE: Scripts are write-only executors and never compute mode or identity.
27) SCRIPT INPUT: Scripts consume bundle data already inside this JSON.
28) CONFLICT RULE: Snapshot truth wins over paraphrase or memory in CONTINUE.
29) RECOVERY RULE: On mismatch, regenerate deterministically from snapshot truth.
30) DETERMINISM RULE: Same inputs must produce same outputs.
golden_rules: CONTINUE TRUTH: Use snapshot metadata as the only project identity source in CONTINUE.
NO DISK DECISIONS: Disk is storage only.
SINGLE BUNDLE: One JSON includes snapshot and embedded scripts.
SEQUENCE ONLY: IDs and filenames are sequence-driven with no temporal data.
NO INVENTION: Keep UNKNOWN for missing facts.

required_user_inputs: project name only when topic cannot yield stable deterministic naming
assistant_must_do: If init_intake.project_name_human is UNKNOWN, derive from chat context and record source metadata.

required_user_inputs: previous snapshot object provided at chat start
assistant_must_do: Parse previous snapshot and read prev_seq from identity.chat_sequence.
Set new_seq = prev_seq + 1 with strict monotonicity.
Keep project name/key/label exactly from snapshot metadata.

user_provides_at_trigger: snapshot object at chat start when continuing an existing project
handoff.assistant_output_format: Must output one JSON bundle containing snapshot data and embedded_files.

decision_source_of_truth.chat_sequence: CONTINUE: only from provided snapshot identity.chat_sequence. INIT_NEW: fixed to 1.
decision_source_of_truth.project_identity: CONTINUE: only from provided snapshot project block. INIT_NEW: from init_intake or deterministic derivation from chat context.
decision_source_of_truth.title_and_display_name: Derived deterministically from chat inputs and naming_policy only.

assistant_guardrails.no_reinterpretation_rule: When machote limpio is present, assistant output must follow this schema.
assistant_guardrails.no_invented_data_rule: Assistant must not invent facts; use UNKNOWN when not deterministic.
assistant_guardrails.anti_drift_rule: If memory or paraphrase conflicts with provided snapshot, snapshot wins in CONTINUE.
assistant_guardrails.sequence_rule: new_seq = prev_seq + 1 using snapshot identity.chat_sequence only.
assistant_guardrails.project_key_stability_rule: project.key is immutable once established unless user explicitly overrides.
assistant_guardrails.minimal_change_rule: Preserve confirmed facts between chats unless explicitly updated by user or deterministic derivation.
assistant_guardrails.conflict_resolution_rule: Record conflicts in drift_and_contradictions and proceed with snapshot-truth determinism.

script_must_not: Search directories to guess project identity
Infer mode from disk or filesystem conditions
Read LATEST.json to compute sequence or state
Compute snapshot_id, display_name, or project identity
Request interactive merge or copy steps
Modify machote template file or schema
script_must: Treat project.storage_dir from snapshot as authoritative target path in CONTINUE.
Create target folder idempotently when missing.
Write snapshot JSON exactly to target snapshot path from snapshot metadata.
Write or overwrite LATEST.json as exact copy of snapshot JSON.
Log saved snapshot path and next_chat.display_name.
Support single bundle execution using embedded_files.
